title: Which Demographic Features Are Relevant for Individual Fairness Evaluation of U.S. Recidivism Risk Assessment Tools?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured human perceptions of fairness regarding recidivism risk assessment tools when considering demographic features like race, age, and sex.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. The study focuses exclusively on the demographic features of race, sex, and age in the context of individual fairness for recidivism risk assessment tools.
